title: Cash-and-Carry from K163 HL FR Signal
hypothesis: K163 secondary finding: HL hourly funding signal predicts next Bybit 8H FR with mean Spearman IC +0.128 (8/8 sym p<0.05) but predicts price ~0. We monetise the funding-leg edge via delta-neutral cash-and-carry (long spot + short perp) when predicted FR > threshold.
verdict_reason: Best variant V_q85_h2 OOS Sharpe=-161.46 <= 0.3 after costs; funding-leg edge fails to cover costs.
